title: Cloud Set Airy Setting Spray + Smoothing Mist
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Alcohol Free✓ Fragrance Free✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Long-wearing✓ Non-Comedogenic

What it is: A refreshing, skin-caring settingspray mist that hydrates, smooths, and locks makeup in place for 12 hours. Alcohol free + non-comedogenic.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, and Combination


Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Pores, and Uneven Texture


Formulation: Mist


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Agave Tequilana Leaf and Fruit Extracts: Smooth and reduce the appearance of lines and texture.

- Saccharide Isomerate and Trehalose: Reduce visible shine while boosting moisture.

- Plant-based Alternatives to Silicones, Acrylates, and Microplastics: Comfortably set makeup in place.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well.
-After applying makeup, hold 8 to 10 inches away and mist over entire face no more than three times; a little goes a long way.
-Reapply as desired for a refreshing boost throughout the day.
-Best for dry, normal, and combination skin.
Ingredients+
-Agave Tequilana Leaf and Fruit Extracts: Smooth and reduce the appearance of lines and texture.
-Saccharide Isomerate and Trehalose: Reduce visible shine while boosting moisture.
-Plant based Alternatives to Silicones, Acrylates, and Microplastics: Comfortably set makeup in place.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Pentylene Glycol, Polyglyceryl-10 Diisostearate, Maltose, Caesalpinia Spinosa Fruit Extract, Pullulan, Sorbitol, Agave Tequilana Leaf Extract, Kappaphycus Alvarezii Extract, Saccharide Isomerate, Acacia Senegal Gum, Trehalose, Sodium Gluconate, Phenethyl Alcohol, Hydroxyacetophenone.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
